shadows.name: card-base
shadows.purpose: Container depth for cards and dashboard panels at rest.

shadows.name: popover-selected
shadows.purpose: Light lift for select dropdowns and the active tab state.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Visible keyboard focus on interactive controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Slate-deep background, slate-paper text, label type. Hover deepens opacity; focus shows a slate-ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); border: none; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 8px 16px; height: 40px; min-width: 40px; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2% / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Destructive action. Signal-red background, slate-paper text. For actions that cannot be undone.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); border: none; background: var(--destructive); color: var(--destructive-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 8px 16px; height: 40px; min-width: 40px; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: hsl(0 84.2% 60.2% / 0.9); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-destructive:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Slate-paper background, slate-ink text, slate-border border. Hover tints to accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); border: 1px solid var(--input); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 8px 16px; height: 40px; min-width: 40px; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line text field. Slate-border stroke, slate-paper background, body type, 40px height.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; height: 40px; width: 100%; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); border: 1px solid var(--input); background: var(--background); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--foreground); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Container surface. Slate-paper background, slate-ink text, lg rounding, one-pixel slate-border, subtle base shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-description { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); margin: 0 0 16px 0; } .ds-card-content { padding: 24px 0 0 0; }

components.name: Tabs Trigger
components.description: Tab trigger in a mist list. Selected state is slate-paper with slate-ink text and light shadow; unselected is muted-foreground.
components.css: .ds-tabs-list { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--muted); padding: 4px; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-tabs-trigger { border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-tabs-trigger:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-tabs-trigger.ds-selected { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-tabs-trigger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ring); }

components.name: Select Trigger
components.description: Select field trigger. Matches input styling with a chevron indicator; open state shows a popover with shadow-md.
components.css: .ds-select { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; } .ds-select-trigger { display: flex; height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: between; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); border: 1px solid var(--input); background: var(--background); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--foreground); outline: none; appearance: none; width: 100; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-select-trigger:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-select-trigger:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-select-chevron { width: 16px; height: 16px; opacity: 0.5; margin-left: 8px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-select-popover { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 4px); left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 50; max-height: 384px; min-width: 200px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); border: 1px solid var(--input); background: var(--popover); color: var(--popover-foreground); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Checkbox control. Rounded-sm border in slate-input, slate-ring focus ring, check drawn in currentColor.
components.css: .ds-checkbox { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-checkbox-input { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; opacity: 0; position: absolute; cursor: pointer; } .ds-checkbox-indicator { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 4px); border: 1px solid var(--input); background: var(--background); margin-right: 8px; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-checkbox-indicator::after { content: ""; width: 12px; height: 12px; background: currentColor; clip-path: polygon(14% 44%, 0 60%, 45% 100%, 55% 90%, 78% 58%, 100% 22%, 100% 22%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-checkbox:has(.ds-checkbox-input:checked) .ds-checkbox-indicator { background: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); } .ds-checkbox:has(.ds-checkbox-input:checked) .ds-checkbox-indicator::after { opacity: 1; color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-checkbox-input:focus-visible ~ .ds-checkbox-indicator { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-checkbox-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-checkbox-input:disabled ~ .ds-checkbox-indicator { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Field Label
components.description: Field label. Label type (500, 0.875rem), no leading, medium weight.
components.css: .ds-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; color: var(--foreground); display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-label:has(+ :disabled), .ds-label:has(> :disabled) { opacity: 0.7; }

narrative.overview: A dashboard-grade control room for digital agencies managing many TikTok creators and accounts from one place. The system is precise and confident, built on clean utility: plenty of white space, weight and size carrying hierarchy, and color held in reserve so that when it does appear it means something. Surfaces are white or near-white slate, text is deep slate ink, and interactive states lift subtly. TikTok's brand red and cyan appear only at brand touchpoints — never as decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Industrial and efficient components: clear states, distinct borders, visible focus rings, built for speed.
Slate & Signal palette: deep slate depth, paper-white surfaces, mist backgrounds, signal red for destructive actions.
Flat-by-default depth: subtle shadows on cards, selects, and popovers only; no zero-blur block shadows.

The One Brand-Touchpoint Rule. TikTok red (#fe2c55) and cyan (#25f4ee) are reserved for TikTok brand moments (connect, auth, publishing status). They are never used as decorative accents on agency UI.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: One typeface, one scale. Display weight steps are obvious (800 → 700 → 600 → 500 → 400); do not introduce intermediate weights or a second family for emphasis.

rules.name: The One Brand-Touchpoint Rule
rules.body: TikTok red (#fe2c55) and cyan (#25f4ee) are reserved for TikTok brand moments (connect, auth, publishing status). They are never used as decorative accents on agency UI.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus) or container role (card, popover). Never as decoration.

dos: Do use Slate Deep (primary ink) on ≤10% of any given screen; its rarity is the point.
Do keep focus rings visible: 2px slate-ring with 2px offset on every interactive control.
Do carry heading hierarchy by weight and size only (800 → 700 → 600 → 500 → 400); never add a second typeface.
Do reserve TikTok red (#fe2c55) and cyan (#25f4ee) for TikTok brand touchpoints only.
donts: Don't use gradient text, glass/blur as decoration, or zero-blur block shadows (4px 4px 0) — this world is flat-by-default.
Don't add eyebrows/kickers above headings or section numbers (01/02/03); the heading carries its own weight.
Don't nest cards; cards are the container, never nested inside one another.
Don't apply TikTok brand colors as decorative accents on agency UI.
